_comment: Copy this, replace every value, delete the _comment keys. This is the ONLY input assemble.py needs. Do not re-derive the shape from the source.
_comment_graph_id: omit entirely for new_question — a stable id is minted from the question
question: does IRAK4 inhibition affect synovial fibroblasts
_comment_target: null for new_question; a things/links/gaps id otherwise
_comment_status: your judgement of THIS round: ok | empty | partial | failed

coverage._comment_stop_reason: max_papers | queries_exhausted | no_new_results | time_limit | complete | search_unavailable

_comment_coverage: the REAL numbers. no_quote_discarded and duplicates_dropped are added by the script — do not set them.

things.name: IRAK4
things._comment_kind: protein | small_molecule | gene | disease | process | method
things._comment_uniprot_accession: REQUIRED on every protein/gene node. Resolve it with `search -s proteins "<name> human"`. Species matters: IRAK4 also matches Q1RMT8 (bovine) and Q8R4K2 (mouse). Omit on diseases, processes, methods and small molecules.
things.resolved_by: f1 quote names IRAK4 as the kinase inhibited
things._comment_resolved_by: resolve from the QUOTE, not the label. "IL-6" resolves to P05231 the ligand, but receptor-blockade evidence is P08887.
things._comment_ambiguity: rejected candidates + why. A node with a non-empty ambiguity is never used as a merge key.

things.name: rheumatoid arthritis
things._comment_t2: The graph MUST carry the disease/indication as its own node when the question concerns one. Downstream consumers should not have to recover it from the question string.

_comment_things: only NEW or newly-aliased entities. Existing ones keep their ids; the script merges by normalized name and alias.

papers.title: The IRAK4 Inhibitor PF-06650833 Blocks Inflammation in Preclinical Models of Rheumatic Disease
papers._comment_first_author: the FIRST name in authors — not the last, not the corresponding author
papers._comment_study_type: meta_analysis | clinical_trial | human_cohort | animal | test_tube | computational | review
papers.source_text: …the exact text you fetched, with its L<n> prefixes…
papers._comment_source_text: REQUIRED for quote verification. Every quote is string-matched against it and dropped if it does not match. Stripped from the output.

findings.quote: PF-06650833 substantially reduced cytokine and matrix metalloproteinase (MMP) release in response to all ligands profiled.
findings._comment_quote: VERBATIM. Not paraphrased, not cleaned up, not stitched across an ellipsis.
findings.where: RA FLS, TLR ligands Pam3Cys/LPS/flagellin, 100 nM
findings._comment_where: the experimental conditions. explain_disagreement compares these, so this field is load-bearing, not decoration.
findings._comment_section: abstract | introduction | results | methods | discussion | figure_caption
findings._comment_is_own_result: false for a claim the paper CITES rather than shows. A review restating forty studies is one paper, not forty.
